schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE INSURANCE (
    PID INT,
    TIV_2015 NUMERIC,
    TIV_2016 NUMERIC,
    LAT NUMERIC,
    LON NUMERIC,
    PRIMARY KEY (PID),
    CHECK (TIV_2015 >= 0),
    CHECK (TIV_2016 >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) AND (LAT,LON) IN (SELECT LAT,LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT,LON HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
q2: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) AS TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE I1 WHERE 2<=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INSURANCE I2 WHERE I2.TIV_2015=I1.TIV_2015) AND (1=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INSURANCE I3 WHERE I3.LAT=I1.LAT AND I3.LON=I1.LON))
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) AND (LAT,LON) IN (SELECT LAT,LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT,LON HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) AS TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE I1 WHERE 2<=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INSURANCE I2 WHERE I2.TIV_2015=I1.TIV_2015) AND (1=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INSURANCE I3 WHERE I3.LAT=I1.LAT AND I3.LON=I1.LON))
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because they have different conditions for filtering the data. Q1 checks for unique (LAT, LON) pairs and TIV_2015 values that appear more than once, while Q2 checks for (LAT, LON) pairs that appear exactly once and TIV_2015 values that appear at least twice.
